decision: Scan set = Drive 'Porsche 911 GT3 (992)' 2023-11-23 capture: full car 1YfOaWItkXzS_lUNjc3VjMTIJ0SjlY-Fj + 21 part/state scans from the same batch; 992.2 (2026) folder, 2023-08 Exterior, 2024/2025 underbody/wing-HD and 2026 exhaust folders not used
why: Same Artec session as the parts (createdTime 2023-11-23 for car and parts); regcheck medians 1.1-2.3 mm on 17 of 21 parts. The 992.2 car is a different car/frame, the exhaust/underbody scans are not body panels

decision: One rigid levelling transform (huracan-evo tools/level.py, RANSAC ground plane -> +Z, long axis -> Y, flip_y so front = -Y) applied to every scan; car prepped once (car4.json) and every part/composite prepped --like car4.json
why: Raw Artec frame tilted ~4.8 deg with a scanned ground plane; one shared transform keeps all states registered (lesson: never re-normalise a part)

decision: Dropped 8 debris triangles below the ground (z -94..-232 mm) before prep (tools/zcut.py)
why: They set prep's floor 0.23 m too low; after the cut the car is 4.567 m long and 1.277 m high (992 GT3 spec 4,573 x 1,279 mm)

decision: Parts are NOT footprint-cropped; only cut below 12 mm (ground) + drop islands
why: ive crop --footprint-from removed 91 % of the side skirt and 69 % of the diffuser (low parts near the ground)

decision: Registered parts used: Front_Bumper, Rear_Bumper, Rear_Diffuser, Rear_Lip, Rear_Wing, rear_duckbill, SideSkirt (+ states Front_Hood_Open, FR_wheel_well, SideSkirt_Removed, Rear_End_No_Diffuser, Rear_End_Trunk_Open_Lights_Out, rear_wing_mounting_reference). Not used: Left_Side_Bumper_Trim, Right_Side_Trim, Rear_Cover_M
why: tools/regcheck.py: used parts sit 1.1-2.3 mm (Front_Bumper 5 mm, 0.5 deg) from the car with ICP corrections <=5.5 mm; red-over-grey renders (chk/reg_sheet.jpg) show z-fighting = same surface. The three small trims need 113-281 mm / 3-7 deg ICP corrections - not in the car's frame

decision: Hood lid = full-car triangles in the frunk zone > 8 mm from the 'Front Hood Open' scan, largest connected piece (tools/lid.py + biggest.py); hinges -62 deg about its rear edge (pivot x0 y-0.87 z0.86) over comp_hood (car minus lid + frunk from the state scan, zmax 900 mm raw drops the captured lid stub)
why: No hood part scan exists; the open-state scan has the frunk but not the lid, so the difference is exactly the lid. A 911 front lid hinges at the windscreen end

decision: No decklid-open shot; the engine lid (rear_duckbill) only lifts off in the exploded view
why: 'Rear End Trunk Open Lights Out' engine bay has large holes from a hinge-open angle; it reads fine as background structure in the exploded view

decision: Exploded base comp_x = car minus hood, front/rear bumpers, diffuser, rear lip, wing, duckbill lid, right side skirt + fills Front_Hood_Open, FR_wheel_well, SideSkirt_Removed, Trunk_Open, Rear_End_No_Diffuser, rear_wing_mounting_reference (ferrari-296 tools/composite.py)
why: Lessons: state scans as captured over the trimmed full car; checked from 5 angles (chk/cx.png): radiators, exhaust and mufflers, engine bay read as real structure, no hollow shells

decision: Logo = Drive IllumaestheticLogoColor-01.png (1cZJj521P88T_vC2YZDJVVUCctGyNoukR) copied to remotion/public/illumaesthetic_logo.png
why: Gitignored file was missing and illumaesthetic.com returns a Shopify bot-check (429); it is the same white+red wordmark that ends the Temerario reel (Drive 'Illumaesthetic Scan Animation/Temerario.mov', 14cesjzW23h6EW2H2kLRcIhHZqxzq1T--)

decision: Watched the actual Temerario reference (Drive Temerario.mov, 1440x1920 60 fps, 39.8 s): contact sheet confirms turntables -> wheel close-up -> front opens -> top-down spin -> exploded layers -> logo ~50 % width on black
why: Siblings could not download it from Dropbox; the Drive copy is reachable with the service account

decision: Music = porsche-gt3-992_track.mp3 from the coordinating session (generated for this car); measured with ive beats + tools/music_grid.py (numpy, kick band 40-120 Hz): ~123.6 BPM, quiet intro to 15.5 s with accents every 8 beats at 4.151/8.022/11.894, drop on the first kick 15.552, broadband accents 19.739/23.621/27.503, last hit 30.906, reverb tail, silent ~32.3 s; file is 40.0 s long
why: Brief: cut on the track's accents and measure where it really ends (generated tracks end early: music stops at 30.9 s, file runs 40 s). librosa is not installed here, hence the numpy tool

decision: Timeline: s1 front 3/4 0-4.17, s2 rear 3/4 -8.03, s3 brake close-up -9.97, s4 wing close-up -11.9, s5 front lid opens -15.57, s6 top-down -19.73, s7 exploded view -30.9 (separate on 19.74, lock on 27.50, assembled rear 3/4 to the last hit), logo 30.9-33.0; cuts on whole frames
why: Temerario order; calm turntables and close-ups over the quiet intro, the drop lands on the top-down move, the two strongest drop accents bracket the explode (separate/lock), the logo lands on the final hit over the tail. Holds vary 1.9-11.2 s (lessons: vary holds)

decision: Close-up 1 = front-right brake from the 'FR wheel well' state scan at 1.5 mm, not the full car's wheel
why: The full-car wheel has scan fragments inside the spokes (preview); the wheel-off state shows the cross-drilled disc, caliper and spring cleanly

decision: Close-up 2 = swan-neck wing mounts + duckbill engine lid from a 2 mm rear crop
why: GT3 signature detail; the 2 mm crop keeps memory down (style guide: <=2 mm for close-ups)

decision: Front lid opens -62 deg from 0.97 s to 3.3 s into s5, camera from the car's left front, high, easing in
why: Finishes before the drop; from this side the open lid hides most of the hole in the frunk floor of the state scan

decision: Explode camera: high behind the car (-174 deg) orbiting to rear-right (-128), r 5.6->5.4 m, 26 mm; car length runs up the 9:16 frame; rear bumper lifted 0.55 m instead of pulled straight back, diffuser/lip down-back, wing 1.75 m up, lid 1.0 m up, hood 1.05 m up and forward, front bumper 1.05 m forward, right skirt out 0.7 m
why: First two previews (side orbit) pushed the 7 m exploded length out of the 9:16 frame and rear parts flew at the lens; from behind and above everything stays in frame (lessons: stack parts above, keep them off the lens)

decision: Framing fixes after the 30 % previews: s1 ends at -54 deg (not side-on), s2 higher (1.15-1.6 m) so the wing reads against black, s3 pulled back to 33 mm so the ragged state-scan edge stays small
why: Previews: s1/s2 drifted to plain side profiles, s3 at 42 mm showed the scan's cut edge

decision: Renders: 1080x1920 at 75 %, 12 spp, 15 fps, interpolated to 30 fps in assembly (minterpolate); one Blender at a time (tools/render_all.sh)
